name: text-me-plugin
description: Text yourself from a workflow: sends a message to the phone linked in Settings → Text Annie (mobile.agnt.gg). Each text counts against your monthly allowance.
author: AGNT

schema.title: Text Me
schema.description: Sends a text message to your linked phone (Text Annie). Only works for the signed-in account owner. Reports queue acceptance, not delivery.

message.description: The text to send: plain words, no markdown (1-1600 characters).

sent.description: True when the text gateway accepted the message into its send queue.

messageId.description: Gateway message id, or null if not sent.

error.description: Why nothing was sent, or null.
